## The question

IFT-BioSim is a farm-level transition modelling framework for examining how agricultural adjustment differs across heterogeneous farms under common national policy objectives.

It asks how opportunity costs, structural conditions, participation decisions, income effects, land reallocation and policy design interact when transition is implemented at farm level.

## What the model represents

The framework is designed to distinguish farms that face very different economic and structural conditions under the same transition objective.

Core elements include:

- heterogeneous farm structure;
- livestock adjustment;
- opportunity costs;
- behavioural participation;
- income and distributional effects;
- land reallocation; and
- transition-support design.

## Policy instruments

The model can be used to compare alternative instruments and allocation rules, including levies, recycling mechanisms, auction-style approaches and differentiated support.

The purpose is not only to estimate aggregate adjustment, but to understand who responds, who bears costs, and how policy design changes incidence.
